received_works.body:
Hello Ichiru! I hope you’ve been doing well. It’s been a while since I last requested a commission from you. The piece you made back then, the one with her holding the purple rose, is still my absolute favourite! I’m planning to take a break from Skeb after this request, but I’d love to ask for one more special piece from you.

For this piece, I’d love it to capture a serene, free, and uplifting mood, something that feels like a quiet, beautiful moment of freedom.

I’d like you to draw the same pink-haired character in her usual gothic-style outfit with her hat. I’m imagining her sitting on a cathedral rooftop at sunset, with one hand resting beside her for support and the other reaching forward as if feeling the wind. The breeze should make her hair, hat ribbon, and skirt edges flow naturally. Her expression can be calm and happy, with a gentle smile as she enjoys the moment.

The details below are just suggestions, so please feel free to change or leave out anything as you see fit. Perhaps show her from mid-thigh up (similar to the previous commission), from a slight low angle. Let the sunset light softly illuminate her face and outfit details, with some shadows under the hat brim for depth. It would be nice to include ornate stonework or spires behind her, and maybe some petals or feathers drifting in the wind for atmosphere.

I fully trust your artistic sense for composition and lighting,  please feel free to adjust any details as you see fit to match your style.  

I am happy to adjust the amount if needed. Thank you for your consideration!

Hi Ichiru, hope you are doing well! I would like to request another commission from you.

I have this request in mind for a while and am hoping you can make it come true. Been thinking of seeing an illustration of my PSO2 characters. There are 3 characters that I want you to draw and I want something like a family photo. 

1) Chexina would be the same as usual, sharp chin and elf-like ears. Usually in a black and pink outfit. She would be the oldest caring sister and the tallest one out of the three, just slightly taller than Cilira. 

2) Cilira has a tomboy and sassy personality. Her outfit colour scheme is usually black and green. She has different iris colours. The main hair colour is black and the sub-colour is mint green. 

2)Sengami is cute and clumsy. She is the shortest of all three, she is usually dressed in a Japanese-themed outfit. The hair colour is mainly blue. 

The references are mainly there for you to get a feel of how they look. You don't have to use any of the outfits and hairstyles. You can adjust or mix and match them. I will let you decide on the hairstyle, outfit, expression and colours for all three characters.

You don't have to worry too much about the background, if possible can you please focus more on the characters? As for pose, I would like them to have some body contact with each other. 

I understand this request included multiple characters, if the amount is not enough or if there are any issues please appeal to me. Thank you for your time and consideration!
